check.description: The shell command run through sh; the watch answers once a run of it exits 0.

every.description: Seconds between runs of the check, 60 where not given; a run that outlasts it is ended.

note.description: What the answer says once the check holds or the watch lapses: what you are to remember then.

within.description: Seconds after which a check that has not held ends the watch as lapsed; none where not given.
